title: When the Harvest Sings
author: A. M. Amberdale
blurb: Lior Kavanagh, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
